messages:
natalie: PM asked for a 'representative preview' for audit exports: not just recent events, but a small set showing coverage across actor roles and change types.

omar: We can bucket by role (admin/svc/user) + change_type (create/update/delete) and pick top-k per bucket. That avoids previews full of noise.

lee: UX: show a little "coverage" bar per row (how many similar events) and a badge explaining why a field is sensitive. Keep preview rows pre-masked for PII by default.

natalie: Also need explicit quota estimate in the preview, plus an ability to reduce scope to lower quota cost (time range slider).

omar: API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports/preview {query, buckets, per_bucket} -> {preview_id, samples_ndjson, estimated_credits}. Seed sampler with preview_id so preview is reproducible.

lee: Security: preview must include metadata per row: redactable_fields, sensitivity_reasons. Presigned download TTL default 1h, and link creation must emit export.link.created event.

security-bot: policy/checklist: require signed manifest for full exports (later), audit trail for preview toggles, and admin opt-in to reveal masked values.

natalie: Action: omar prototype deterministic bucket sampler, lee mock slide-over with coverage bars, security to document checklist. Aim to ship preview + commit API next sprint.

omar: Starting branch preview-bucket-sampler now.

lee: will add a small telemetry flag export.preview.used.

natalie: thanks team! I'll file a tiny spec and ping legal for masking rules.
